basics.name: Brandon Wu
basics.label: Cybersecurity builder, technical leader, and PhD student focused on practical security at scale
basics.summary: Senior cybersecurity leader and PhD student in Cyber Operations with a track record of building and operating security programs in highly regulated and technology-intensive environments. Experienced in security strategy, architecture, and engineering, as well as advising executive leadership and boards on risk, governance, and long-term security investment. Academic and applied interests focus on practical cyber defense and improving the alignment between cybersecurity workforce supply and organizational demand.

work.name: Block
work.summary: Leading cross-organizational initiatives to improve information security at scale and provide technical leadership across platform infrastructure (network, compute, cloud), corporate security, and identity domains, with a focus on aligning security priorities to business and delivery needs.

work.name: Block
work.summary: Supported product and engineering teams in identifying, prioritizing, and mitigating security risks across Block’s Payment Platform and E-commerce businesses.

work.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
work.summary: Advised organizations operating in regulated and high-scale environments on building, securing, and governing workloads in the cloud, with a focus on translating security, risk, and compliance requirements into practical technical and operational decision.

work.name: WeightWatchers
work.summary: Transformed cybersecurity program from a compliance-driven, reactive function into a proactive risk-based capability aligned to brand protection, product development, and business operations.

work.name: Betterment
work.summary: Built and operating the security, privacy, and risk program for a regulated fintech platform managing $13B+ in assets, serving as the primary interface with regulators and external auditors.
